name: BRAINTEASER
ability_definition: The ability to come up with unusual or clever ideas about a given topic or situation, or to develop creative ways to solve a problem.

task_realism.reasoning: Tasks are riddle-style sentence and word puzzles that require overriding default commonsense associations. That touches the lateral-thinking side of originality. Real workplace originality looks different: devising new product ideas, workarounds, designs or strategies for open-ended, domain-grounded problems. Puzzle-solving trivia is only loosely related.

evaluation_conditions.reasoning: Evaluation is zero-shot on isolated items with a single predetermined correct answer. There is no problem context, no constraints to balance, no iteration or feedback, and no stakes. Semantic and context reconstructions test robustness to memorization, not creative performance under realistic conditions. Workplace originality is judged by novelty and usefulness, which these conditions do not capture.

construct_coverage.reasoning: The benchmark measures only whether a model can recognize the unconventional answer among fixed options. The core of the ability is generating unusual or clever ideas: fluency, novelty, breadth of alternatives, and workable creative solutions. None of that is assessed. It covers a narrow receptive slice of lateral thinking.

format_match.reasoning: The format is forced multiple choice with a 'none of the above' option. Real originality outputs are open-ended proposals, designs, plans or solution sketches. Selecting a letter from preset options is an artificial format far removed from real work artifacts.

transferability_reasoning: BRAINTEASER tests whether a model can recognize lateral-thinking answers to riddles in a multiple-choice format. Originality in the workplace requires producing novel, workable ideas for open-ended problems. Its tasks, conditions and format all diverge sharply from real creative work, and it covers only a receptive sliver of the construct, so strong scores would say little about real-world originality.

2023.metric: accuracy (%), Sentence Puzzle subtask, overall instance-based accuracy across original, semantic and context variants
2023.human_reference: General adult / educated workforce solving lateral-thinking riddles (the typical person who uses clever, unconventional reasoning at work)
